Compendiums.Name: Translate the compendiums
Compendiums.Hint: Only with the Português (Brasil) language: shows the names, descriptions and rules of the system compendiums in Portuguese.

Display.Name: Translate tags and skill fields
Display.Hint: Only with the Português (Brasil) language: shows tags and the Timing, Range, Target, Cost, Limit and Check fields in Portuguese. The stored values stay in English.

World.Title: Translate world documents
World.MenuHint: Only with the Português (Brasil) language: translates the world actors and items that came from the system compendiums and are still in English.
World.Hint: World documents that came from the system compendiums get their Portuguese name and effect names.
World.DescriptionsHint: Replaces the current description with the translated compendium one.
World.Backup: Back up the world before you continue.
World.NoLanguage: Choose the Português (Brasil) language to use this tool.
